en:4764499820620a79a02f.source: Give queued audio an explicit ownership policy. The updated sample converter returns independent PCM storage even when formats already match, so later reuse of the input does not overwrite queued audio. A buffer supplied by an audio callback must not be assumed to remain immutable after the callback returns. If you queue it for later use, arrange a suitable owned copy or a pipeline whose buffer lifetime is controlled. Keep per-buffer UI mutations off the audio callback. For production, also decide how you bound queued work and handle overload or route changes.

en:6d2b0691643affdfc41a.source: Why does this category exist at all when general-purpose note apps are everywhere? Because friction kills capture. If your tool requires you to choose a folder, pick a category, set a tag, or wait two seconds for the editor to load, the thought is gone. The note-to-self category exists precisely because that friction has a measurable cost on what survives from your brain to a place you can act on it.

en:e6bd33024454fbb1507b.source: ZXQ0000 was never a storage app. It was a send-to-email app. Every time you tapped "Send" in ZXQ0001, the app composed a real email and delivered it to your inbox. That email lives on your email provider's servers -- ZXQ0002, ZXQ0003, ZXQ0004 Mail, or wherever you set it up -- completely independent of ZXQ0005. When ZXQ0006's service ended, the memos it had already delivered stayed in your inbox, because each one had been sent to you as an ordinary email.
en:e6bd33024454fbb1507b.text: ZXQ0000は決してストレージアプリではありませんでした。 それはメール送信アプリでした。 ZXQ0001で「Send」をタップするたびに、アプリは実際のメールを作成し、受信トレイに配信します。 そのメールは、メールプロバイダーのサーバー（ZXQ0002、ZXQ0003、ZXQ0004 Mail、または設定した場所）に保存されており、ZXQ0005とは完全に独立しています。 ZXQ0006 のサービスが終了した際、すでに配信されたメモは受信トレイに残っていました。各メモは通常のメールとして送信されていたためです。

en:e6dbd93895a6c8b7ab3f.source: This design trades expressiveness for predictability. Questions come from a fixed list, and the note is the user's own sentences grouped under a title; the model does not summarize or rephrase anything. Choosing the next question is still a model decision, so it can pick a less useful angle. The user can end the exchange at any time and edit the note before saving it.
en:e6dbd93895a6c8b7ab3f.text: この設計は、表現の自由度を抑える代わりに、予測しやすさを得ています。質問は固定の一覧から選び、メモはユーザー自身の文を見出しの下にまとめます。モデルによる要約や言い換えはしません。ただし、次の質問を選ぶのはモデルなので、役に立ちにくい観点を選ぶことはあります。ユーザーはいつでも対話を終え、保存前にメモを編集できます。
